# crosswork_data_gateway_destinations (Data Source)

This data source can read a data destination of the Crosswork Data Gateways by its name or its id, including the system-defined destinations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_data_gateway_destinations" "example" {
  name = "cwtest-gen-destination"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Id of the destination; set either this or `name`
- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.
- `name` (String) Name of the destination; set either this or `id`

### Read-Only

- `auth_type` (String) Authentication of the secure communication; a gRPC destination takes only `mutual`
- `batch_size` (Number) Batch size of a Kafka destination in bytes
- `buffer_memory` (Number) Buffer memory of a Kafka destination in bytes
- `collectors` (Attributes List) Values of a Kafka destination that replace the global ones for one collector (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collectors))
- `compression_method` (String) Compression of the data
- `connections` (Attributes List) Addresses of the destination server, each an IPv4 address with a prefix length or a host name with a domain name (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--connections))
- `data_source` (String) Source of the data sent to the destination
- `dispatch_type` (String) Dispatch type of a gRPC destination
- `encoding` (String) Encoding of the data, for the data source `data-gateway`
- `linger_time` (Number) Linger time of a Kafka destination in milliseconds
- `max_message_size` (Number) Maximum message size of a Kafka destination in bytes
- `request_timeout` (Number) Request timeout of a Kafka destination in seconds
- `secure` (Boolean) Enable secure communication
- `server_type` (String) Type of the destination server
- `system_defined` (Boolean) Whether Crosswork defined the destination, which makes it read-only

<a id="nestedatt--collectors"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collectors`

Read-Only:

- `batch_size` (Number) Batch size in bytes
- `buffer_memory` (Number) Buffer memory in bytes
- `linger_time` (Number) Linger time in milliseconds
- `name` (String) Collector
- `request_timeout` (Number) Request timeout in seconds


<a id="nestedatt--connections"></a>
### Nested Schema for `connections`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) IPv4 address
- `domain_name` (String) Domain name
- `host_name` (String) Host name
- `port` (Number) Port of the server
- `prefix_length` (Number) Prefix length of the IPv4 address
